description.value: Forward Harbour/ƛəx̌əʷəyəm Conservancy is a protected wilderness area on Vancouver Island in BC's South Central Coast region, managed by BC Parks. The conservancy carries cultural significance for Indigenous Peoples and is acknowledged in BC Parks' ongoing reconciliation work. Hunting is permitted during open season under BC regulations, making it a destination for backcountry users venturing into this remote coastal landscape.
